question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Final result with all 50 rows preview
WITH first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.rental_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC, p.payment_id ASC) as rn
    FROM payment p
),
first_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.customer_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        i.film_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    INNER JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    WHERE fr.rn = 1
),
customer_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie fm
INNER JOIN customer_amounts ca ON fm.customer_id = ca.customer_id
INNER JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fm.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating
